task.text: What questions about religion can heritability perhaps address?

attempts.high: I'm putting together a piece on behavior genetics and religion and I want a fresh angle. Come up with the framing yourself — pick whatever questions about religious belief or practice you think heritability research could actually illuminate, and build the discussion however you see fit. Your call on structure and emphasis, just make it genuinely interesting.
attempts.low: Using this list, state which questions about religion heritability studies address: (1) whether religiosity is partly inherited, (2) whether religious affiliation vs. intensity differ in heritability, (3) how shared environment compares to genes. For each, just report the standard finding from twin studies in one sentence. Don't add questions of your own or reframe the list.
